March 3, 2025

# Northwind opens Harbor branch

PORTSMITH—Northwind Community Credit Union opened its Harbor branch at 120 Pier Rd. on Monday.

Branch hours are:

**Lobby**

Monday-Friday: 9 a.m.-5 p.m.

Saturday: 9 a.m.-noon

Sunday: Closed

**Drive-up**

Monday-Friday: 8 a.m.-6 p.m.

Saturday: 8 a.m.-1 p.m.

**ABOUT NORTHWIND COMMUNITY CREDIT UNION**

Northwind Community Credit Union is a member-owned financial cooperative. It has 12 branch office locations and 300 employees.
